# sra_oracle_tunnel_jump (Resource)

Manages an Oracle Tunnel Jump Item.

NOTE: PRA only. Requires PRA 26.3.1 or later.

Vault account jump item associations accept only MSSQL protocol tunnels on the appliance, so this type can't be associated with a vault account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage example Oracle Tunnel Jump Item (PRA 26.3.1 or later)
resource "sra_oracle_tunnel_jump" "example" {
  name                  = "Example Oracle Tunnel"
  hostname              = "oracle.example.com"
  jumpoint_id           = 1 # sent to the API as gateway_id
  jump_group_id         = 1 # sent to the API as asset_group_id
  tunnel_listen_address = "127.0.0.3"
  username              = "app_user"
  database              = "ORCLPDB1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String)
- `jump_group_id` (Number) Sent to the API as `asset_group_id`; API errors use that name.
- `jumpoint_id` (Number) Sent to the API as `gateway_id`; API errors use that name.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `database` (String)
- `jump_group_type` (String) `shared` or `personal`. Sent to the API as `asset_group_type`; API errors use that name.
- `jump_policy_id` (Number)
- `session_policy_id` (Number)
- `tag` (String)
- `tunnel_listen_address` (String) Local address the tunnel listens on, within 127.0.0.0/24. Defaults to 127.0.0.1. Sent to the API as `local_address`; API errors use that name.
- `username` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/usr/bin/env bash

# Item can be imported by specifying the ID
terraform import sra_oracle_tunnel_jump.example 123
```
